access_notes: Search results and aggregators are discovery leads, not evidence for numerical claims.
Direct ACM DOI fetch returned HTTP 403; author/arXiv full text and primary indexed publisher text were available.
Zenodo web fetch failed, but the official Zenodo API and DataCite metadata succeeded.
SkillsBench v1 and v4 differ in task/domain/configuration counts; this review cites v4.
SWE-Skills-Bench v1 search snippets differ substantially from v2; this review cites v2.
Author lists can differ between arXiv metadata and a revised full-text header. Recheck publisher BibTeX before manuscript submission.
OpenReview presented a bot-verification page; the ETH institutional publication record supplied the AGENTS.md workshop abstract and venue.
Synoema PDF was downloaded from the official Zenodo API file link and selected evaluation/limitation sections inspected with pdftotext. No artifact claims were replicated.
Synoema's revised 16-task source-count aggregate differs from selected-task reductions in descriptions. Neither is a complete agent-trajectory cost measurement.
All arXiv versions selected in this review are pinned in the manifest; metadata refresh does not constitute a new full-text review.

Xu's LSP study has internal coverage inconsistencies between results and limitations, and its tokens-to-success formula includes successful rollouts only. Treat as preliminary and inspect the artifact before reusing numerical conclusions.
